import collections
import pathlib
import subprocess

paths = set(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).decode().split('\0'))
extensions = {'.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.mjs', '.cjs', '.css', '.scss', '.sass', '.html', '.py', '.sh', '.sql'}
stats = collections.defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0, 0])
tests = [0, 0]
for name in sorted(paths):
    p = pathlib.Path(name)
    if p.suffix not in extensions or not p.is_file():
        continue
    lines = p.read_text().splitlines()
    group = 'Desktop app' if name.startswith('apps/desktop/') else '/'.join(p.parts[:2]) if name.startswith('packages/') else 'Other source / tooling'
    stats[group][0] += 1
    stats[group][1] += len(lines)
    stats[group][2] += sum(bool(line.strip()) for line in lines)
    if '.test.' in p.name:
        tests[0] += 1
        tests[1] += len(lines)
for group, (files, total, nonblank) in sorted(stats.items()):
    print(f'{group}: {total:,} lines ({nonblank:,} nonblank), {files} files')
print(f'TOTAL: {sum(v[1] for v in stats.values()):,} lines ({sum(v[2] for v in stats.values()):,} nonblank), {sum(v[0] for v in stats.values())} source files')
print(f'Tests included: {tests[1]:,} lines, {tests[0]} files')
PY
